node.statement: Fixed-point construction and translation: for any self-map T of a complete metric space with Lipschitz constant c<1, the iterates h_{n+1}=T(h_n) obey ||h_{n+1}-h_n||<=c^n||h_1-h_0||; the geometric-series bound makes them Cauchy, completeness gives h_n->h, and Lipschitz continuity gives T(h)=h. Applied to the T above, h lies in K subset B_r(0) and T(h)=h is exactly g(h)=z. Therefore every z in B_{(1-c)r}(0) lies in g(B_r(0)); and if y=f(x_0)+Vz then g(h)=z implies f(x_0+h)=f(x_0)+Vg(h)=y, with x_0+h in B_r(x_0).
